any previously discussed maneuver or pro: Any Previously Discussed Maneuver or Procedure

overview: This event ties together securing rear cockpit for solo, unauthorized solo maneuvers, and unintentional instrument flight in a way that should already make sense before you step. You should be ready to brief what changes the plan, what numbers matter, and where the usual errors start once the workload climbs.

studyNotes.headline: Discussion items

items.text: Read checklists out loud to reduce omissions.

children.text: Maintain situational awareness while taxiing—use "see-and-avoid" doctrine.
Monitor radio calls, especially those using your call sign.
(N) Set aft UFCP HUD switch to DAY mode for solo flight.

items.text: No spins, stalls, simulated engine failures, PPELs, or maneuvers not previously introduced.

children.text: Unauthorized Solo Maneuvers is judged by how well you enter it, stay ahead of the aircraft, and recover without needing cleanup coaching.
Know the entry airspeed, altitude, configuration, and cockpit setup before you start the maneuver.
a. Maintain control of the aircraft.
b. Establish instrument scan and check altitude.
c. If below MEF+1000’ or OROCA, climb immediately and turn away from obstacles.
File ZOMBIE flight plan using callsign
